q1_issues.issue: The five coordinated object NPs are stacked as five Theme atoms on one record event, but coordinated noun phrases are distributive by default, so the whole predication should be replicated once per conjunct (one record event each).

The definite plural subject yields only a group event; 'record' is not a collective predicate (gather / meet / assemble), so the grouped plural also requires the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x sk_ledger_1) ...) distribution rule.

q2_gaps: a restrictive/descriptive adjective on a BARE-KIND object filler ('notable events' as a non-specific kind-level object): the fuse-vs-split rule and the plural distributive rule both need a witness or group symbol to attach the modifier to, and a bare kind filler has neither, so fusing is the only route that does not silently drop the qualifier
notes: Theme rather than Patient is right (verbs that merely record an object leave it as it was), and 'Council' as a bare capitalized class word correctly stays a common-noun modifier with no Name atom. The coordination rule is stated for coordinated NPs generally but exemplified only on subjects, which may be why the object coordination was stacked onto one event.
